sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head blackish brown, paler anteriorly (including the nasus); antennae and abdomen yellowish brown; pronotum dark brown. Head hairless; pronotum with a few minute hairs; abdominal tergites with minute hairs. Body length (excluding the antennae, including the nasus) 4.23—4.55 mm. Head without the nasus pyriform, strongly constricted below the antennal sockets, the sides distinctly bulging; posterior margin rounded, with a very weak concavity. Nasus slender and columnar, its greatest width slightly less than half the head length, with a few small hairs at the tip; a nearly oval white spot on each side of the head behind the antennal sockets. In lateral view the dorsal margin of the head capsule is strongly incurved, the postoccipital bulge strongly prominent. Fontanelle gland indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, the two basal segments darker than the rest; segment 2 shortest, segment 3 about three times as long as segment 2 and slightly longer than segment 4, segments from 5 to 8 nearly equal in length, segments 9—14 gradually shorter. Mandibles highly reduced, each with a spine-like lateral process near the middle of the outer margin; the edge between the lateral process and the molar region nearly straight, the molar region weakly convex, the lateral process and the molar region nearly equal in length. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, much narrower than the head; anterior lobe small, anterior margin weakly curved outwards, with minute hairs and without a median notch; lateral corners broadly rounded; posterior margin slightly rounded, with a very indistinct median concavity; a white median line divides the pronotum into two equal halves. Legs very long, the hind leg much longer than the others and extending far beyond the end of the abdomen; apical tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate oval, tergites without distinct long hairs, each tergite with a few minute hairs along its posterior margin.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head capsule and postclypeus dark brown; labrum and antennae light brown; thorax and abdominal tergites smoky brown with yellow; coxae and femora yellowish brown, tibiae and tarsi pale yellow. Head sparsely hairy, pronotum with short hairs, tergites sparsely hairy, sternites densely hairy. Head capsule nearly square, slightly wider than long, Y suture distinct. Fontanelle covered by a white translucent narrow-elongate plate, situated in the centre at the junction of the two frontal sutures, slightly concave. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 nearly as long as segment 2, segment 2 shortest and slightly longer than segment 4, segments 5—8 gradually longer and segments 9—15 gradually shorter; behind the antennal sockets a pair of nearly oval white spots on each side. Postclypeus raised, about twice as long, divided longitudinally by a deep median suture, with long setae. Anteclypeus distinct, translucent, hairless. Labrum dome-shaped, wider than long, with a few long setae. Mandibles stout, light brown, the inner margin darker; left mandible with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth well developed, slightly shorter than the 1st marginal tooth, the 1st marginal tooth rather slender, finger-like, the cutting edge wavy, the 2nd marginal tooth well developed, short, far from the 1st marginal tooth; right mandible also with 1 apical and 2 marginal teeth and a well-developed molar plate, the apical tooth slightly shorter than the 1st marginal tooth, the 1st marginal tooth triangular, the 2nd marginal tooth short, the edge of the molar plate wavy. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, much narrower than the head width, wider than long; anterior margin convex, without a notch; anterior lateral corners deeply concave; posterior margin broadly rounded. Legs long and slender, the hind femur extending beyond the end of the abdomen. Abdomen nearly oval, short and thick; cerci 2-segmented; no styli. Small worker: slightly smaller than the large worker, colour and pilosity as in the large worker; head nearly square, slightly wider than long, Y suture distinct, fontanelle as in the large worker; antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 shortest, segment 3 slightly longer than segments 2 and 4, segment 4 nearly equal to segment 2, segments 5—9 gradually longer and segments 10—15 gradually shorter; postclypeus, anteclypeus, labrum and mandibles as in the large worker; pronotum as in the large worker, only the notch of the anterior lateral corners very weak; abdomen as in the large worker.
